method: End-to-end UI verification with employee demonstration account at mobile CSS viewport sizes
checks: Personal and employment information render on the mobile profile; only contact email and phone are editable
Save is disabled until contact values change
Both empty fields produce separate required-field errors and aria-invalid=true; first invalid field receives focus
Email with consecutive dots and phone containing letters are rejected with field-specific messages
Cancel discards invalid drafts and retains original saved contacts
Valid temporary contact email with surrounding spaces and uppercase domain saves as aidana.mobile@example.com
Valid phone starting with 8 saves in canonical +7 format and displays as +7 (700) 000-02-26
Save shows success feedback and exits editing mode
Temporary saved contacts persist after page reload
Personal and employment sections remain identical after contact save, including work email and 16-day vacation balance
Both inputs use 16px font, email/tel types and corresponding autocomplete attributes
Original employee contacts were restored through the form and verified after another reload
reason: No application defect found in verified profile scenarios
limits: Responsive browser verification, not a physical iOS/Android device or on-screen keyboard test
Contact input values are masked by the browser-control tool; restoration used original values observed in the profile display
cleanup: Original contacts restored and verified after reload; viewport override reset
